scope: Audited unchanged engineering demonstration; no behavioural parameter was biologically calibrated by this register.

human_review.decision_record: Separate M5 review record; actual decision has not been received.

primary_software_reference.title: GAMA model reproducibility guidance
primary_software_reference.scope: Software reproducibility conditions, not biological parameter evidence.

execution_scope.comparison_scope: Canonical states under pinned model, configuration and runtime; exclude only run_id from state content. Wall-clock timestamps and machine paths are execution metadata, outside the canonical sequence.
execution_scope.empirical_limit: Passing declared repeated-seed runs does not prove repeatability under parallel execution, display-side randomness, changed runtimes or asynchronous external interactions.
execution_scope.seed_scope: Only the ten predeclared positive seeds in the positive execution plan; requested seed 0 is explicitly excluded after the retained rejected mismatch.

measurement_conventions.duration: Use [t_i,t_(i+1)) intervals; no added interval after t=20. Final surface is right-censored by run stop.
measurement_conventions.coverage: Balanced elapsed label coverage is engineered, not wild occupancy. Sample counts differ due to the endpoint.
measurement_conventions.horizontal_speed: Distinguish instantaneous exported speed from sampled horizontal chord speed.
measurement_conventions.turning: Wrap signed heading differences to [-180,180) before dividing by elapsed simulation time.
measurement_conventions.vertical_rate: Depth increase is positive downward; world-Y velocity is negative. Compare sampled secants to curve secants, not continuous peaks.
measurement_conventions.interval_state: Assign a derivative interval the left sample state label.
measurement_conventions.pose: Retained root-relative geometry bounds and fixed mean plane do not determine wave clearance or breathing.

parameters.measurement_or_constraint: Analytic peak occurs at u=0.5. Sampled 0.5 s finite differences compare to curve secants. World-Y velocity has opposite sign.
parameters.scope_and_uncertainty: Bounded software-demonstration choice; no claim about wild harbour porpoises. These derived rates are not porpoise physiological limits. Derivative interval retains the left sample state label.
